recognize_zh: 密集成片的芽細胞大小略有差異，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質極少，其間夾雜幾顆較小、染色質濃縮的成熟淋巴球作為大小對照，符合淋巴芽細胞白血病的骨髓取代。
features: Sheets of small to intermediate blasts with mild size variation
Very high N:C ratio with scant agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous to small in most cells
Scattered small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin for size comparison; occasional larger cell with more basophilic cytoplasm (lower left)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is diffusely replaced by small to intermediate-sized blasts with mild size variation. The blasts have very high N:C ratios, scant agranular cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered small mature lymphocytes are interspersed, and residual normal hematopoiesis is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia, pending flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; immunophenotyping for cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a is required.
MPO or myeloid antigen expression (CD13, CD33, CD117) by flow cytometry rather than B-lineage markers.
Cells are small mature lymphocytes with clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, not blasts with fine chromatin, and are TdT-negative.
Occur as a minor population with smooth condensed chromatin and show normal B-cell maturation by flow.
